R30.MODULE_AUTHORITY_REASON: The sealed R30 result is available and content-addressed. Slice 1 is derived from its data by committed R28 bound code; neither the freeze nor the census imports or loads R30 code. Four discovered R30 module versions replay the sealed result to the same ledger and the same 992-profile Slice-1 input, but none can be proven to be the producer. R30 module identity is therefore historical provenance, not execution authority, and no R30 module is bound.

PROFILE_FRONTIER.BAND: every T from the cap down while R28 cap_bound(T) > floor
PROFILE_FRONTIER.BOUND_CODE: R28 commit unpacked from Git and run in a child; no R30 code
PROFILE_FRONTIER.CAP: the unique T in [22, W // 3] with R28 cap_bound(T) equal to the sealed ledger bound; it must equal the profile's last sealed OWNER_REFUTATION or plateau certificate cap where one exists
PROFILE_FRONTIER.ORDER: R30 bound descending, then profile digits descending
PROFILE_FRONTIER.SOURCE: sealed R30 result data only: FINAL_RESOLVED_LEDGER, NEXT_ACTIVE_PROFILE, NEXT_ACTIVE_BOUND, REFINEMENT_STEPS and PLATEAU_CERTIFICATES

SLICE1.FLOOR_SEMANTICS: EXCLUSIVE: (profile, T) with R30-envelope bound > FLOOR (FLOOR = R30 NEXT_ACTIVE_BOUND, so no unresolved profile enters)

SOLVER.MODEL: R28 support_union_model, one profile, open-wedge ceiling W - 3T
SOLVER.RETRY_RULE: UNKNOWN at 120 s is retried once at 600 s; only INFEASIBLE refutes a T; FEASIBLE or OPTIMAL realizes it; UNKNOWN after the retry stops that profile
SOLVER.WORKER_EVIDENCE: preflight solves a probe and reads 'with 1 workers' from the CP-SAT log; num_workers stays unset (setting both is MODEL_INVALID in 9.15)

WITNESS.DISTINCTNESS: exact structure no-good: one of the 49 lines must differ
WITNESS.MAPPING: triple line n -> number n + 1 (n < 22), then pair lines -> 23..49
WITNESS.PROXY: K4-quartet S4: sum over overlap-graph K4 of its exact four-ticket weight
